{{Conjecture|legends}}
This '''civilization''' had been lost to the outer [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. However, it was eventually rediscovered by [[Rorworr (Naboo)|Rorworr]], a [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Scout/Legends|scout]], when he disappeared from a Republic exploration party. The Wookiee received an official reprimand from his superiors for his disappearance.
